term_months.notes: Printed as 'פיקדון לשנה', model 401/0 'חסכון צמוד למדד לשנה'; recorded as 12 months, the period of a one-year deposit (directive 447 Annex A, BANK-14).

rate_offered.notes: Nominal annual rate before tax as printed ('0.80 %') for the 1,000 - 99,999 tier of model 401/0 'חסכון צמוד למדד לשנה' ('פיקדון לשנה'): rate type 'קבועה', linkage 'צמוד למדד', break 'אין אפשרות שבירה', automatic renewal 'לא קיימת', number of renewals '-', exit points 'לא קיימת' '-', 'הטבת דיגיטל' '-', 'ריבית מתואמת:' 0.90%; the common-deposit column is empty (p.17). This row as printed: 1,000 - 99,999: '0.80 %', 'ריבית מתואמת:' 0.90%. Read 2026-11-09 from the bank's print file of its 447 publication (the PDF its rate-table page offers), which prints 'הנתונים נכונים ליום: 09.11.2026' and 'שיעור ריבית הפריים הנוכחית: P = 4.75 % החל מתאריך: 03.09.2026'; the file also says 'שיעור הריבית המוצעת הינו לתום תקופת ההפקדה'. The column 'הטבת דיגיטל' is printed beside the rate; whether it is included in the offered rate or added to it is not stated.

source.title: פקודת מס הכנסה [נוסח חדש], נוסח רשות המסים, עמ' 204, סעיף 125ג(ב); עמ' 41, סעיף 9(13)

tax_bucket.notes: Read as fully linked to the consumer price index on the 447 table's linkage column alone (quoted in the notes of rate_offered); no terms document of this deposit was read for its linkage, so whether the linkage is full, which the bucket needs (TXI-04: a deposit counts as linked only when fully linked to the index), rests on that column. Fully linked: the linkage differentials are exempt (TXI-05) and the interest above the linkage is taxed at up to 25% (TXI-02), at a lower bracket from age 60 (TXI-19). Copied from the rule base (sources read there 2026-10-25), not re-read today. The engine reads no tax_bucket today.
